nrr:aiUseDeclaration.statement: We used Claude (Opus 4.8, Opus 5) to suggest wording ideas, copy-edit draft text to match Arcadia's style, clarify and streamline text, and generate figure mockups. We used ChatGPT (GPT-5.6 Luna) to suggest wording ideas and to clarify and streamline text. We also used ChatGPT (GPT-5.6 Sol) to identify reproducibility/clarity issues in our draft, and we corrected the issues it found. Additionally, Gemini (Gemini 3.6 Flash) suggested papers on relevant science, we did further reading, and we cited some of this literature. We reviewed all AI-assisted content and take responsibility for its accuracy and integrity.

nrr:applicabilityConditions.alcalase: 1:10 dilution of Alcalase (Sigma-Aldrich 126741) in TAP, 10 mL per pellet, 1 h in LED grow tent (~7,000 lux, ambient temperature, no shaking); washed twice with TAP + 40 mM sucrose
nrr:applicabilityConditions.cargo: Alt-R S. pyogenes Cas9 V3 (IDT 1081058) with annealed Alt-R crRNA:tracrRNA (IDT 1072533), 5 uM each, 4 uL RNP per reaction; linear 1,589 bp HDR donor: HSP70A-RBCS2::RBCS2i1::NAT::RBCS2-T flanked by 50 bp homology arms, released by SapI (NEB R0569S), gel-purified (Zymo D4001), 1 ug per transformation; synthesised by Twist Bioscience in pTwist Amp High Copy
nrr:applicabilityConditions.comparator: washed twice in 10 mL undiluted GeneArt MAX Efficiency Transformation Reagent for Algae (Thermo Fisher A24229)
nrr:applicabilityConditions.delivery: Gene Pulser Xcell (Bio-Rad), 4 mm cuvettes (VWR 89047-210), 500 V, 50 uF, 800 Ohm; 250 uL cells; recovery overnight in TAP + 40 mM sucrose, dark, 150 rpm
nrr:applicabilityConditions.replicates: n = 1 per condition; one experimenter; one batch of each key reagent
nrr:applicabilityConditions.selection: TAP agar + 7.5 ug/mL nourseothricin (NAT); controls plated on TAP after 100x dilution; 5-7 days in grow tent
nrr:applicabilityConditions.synchronization: 14 h light / 10 h dark for four days before transformation; Fluval Plant 4.0 LED Nano lamps, 11,000 lux at culture surface

nrr:confidence.basis: large effect (>= 10-fold) but n = 1 and one reagent batch

nrr:cost.note: single unreplicated experiment; USD not reported
nrr:cost.source: Figure 1 legend: workflow spans ~18 days from culture synchronization to genotyping

nrr:invalidators: lower Alcalase dose or shorter digestion with osmotic support that restores colony yield
@graph.nrr:outcomeSummary: 35 (flask) and 68 (plate) colonies after Alcalase vs > 1,200 after GeneArt; Alcalase survivors tolerated electroporation at 69% (flask) vs 38% (plate).
@graph.nrr:successCriteria: Colony yield on TAP comparable to GeneArt-washed cells from the same starting density.
